curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can a renegade priest, an occult metalhead, and a hack television prophet commit enough sins to halt the end of the world in time?
curatedMovie.description: After learning the Antichrist's exact birth date, a rogue priest joins forces with a death metal store clerk and a cheesy TV psychic on an urban spree of sacrilege and chaos to stop the Apocalypse.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast, wild, and irreverently funny, delivering manic apocalyptic suspense with heavy comedic bite.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by Álex de la Iglesia, this fast-paced collision of horror, action, and twisted dark comedy turns an apocalyptic mission into an outrageous, irreverent ride.
